settings.privacy_body_1: Ka penapena ngā kī API ki rō pūtirotiro (localStorage) ā ka tukuna ki te API o te kaiwhakarato AI anake — kāore ki tētahi tūmau waenganui. Ka āhei te mukua i nāianei tonu.
settings.privacy_body_2: Ka penapena tēnei taupānga i ono mea ki localStorage: hiahia kaupeka, hiahia reo, tātari pūranga (Ipurangi/Taketake), tautuhinga rapu ora, kaiwhakarato AI hohe, me ngā kī API. Kāore ērā atu raraunga e penapena ana, e tukuna ana rānei.
settings.privacy_body_translations: Nā te AI i hanga ngā whakamāoritanga o te ātea, ā kei roto pea ētahi hapa. Kāore he raraunga ake o te kaiwhakamahi e tukuna ana hei whakamāori.
settings.reduced_motion_note: Kua whakahohea e koe te huri iti, ā kei te mōhio mātou ki tēnā tautuhinga pūnaha. Ka tāwhewhewhe ngā whakairiiringa pēnei i te confetti ā tae noa ki tōu huri i ngā tautuhinga āheitanga OS.

party.announce_full: Kua whakahohea te aratau pāti! Kua huri te momotuhi ki Comic Sans. Kua huri ngā tae ki he ōrite tae mārohirohi matapōkere. Ka hinga confetti kōura mai i runga o te mata i ngā tae me ngā āhua huhua. He mea māhoe ināianei te ihu rākau.
party.announce_reduced: Kua whakahohea te aratau pāti! Kua huri te momotuhi ki Comic Sans. Kua huri ngā tae ki he ōrite tae mārohirohi matapōkere. He mea māhoe ināianei te ihu rākau. I tāwhewhewhe te confetti i te mea kua whakahohea te huri iti.

about.what_body: He kaiwhakaaro tāite mō te tuhituhi arotake wāhia. Rapua i tētahi kaunihi o ngā whakamāramatanga hapa WCAG, tīpakohia tētahi e tūhono ana ki tō kitenga, whakaritea, kōpihia ā-tika ki tō pūrongo arotake.
about.step_1_body: Patohia āu i kite ai — ingoa wāhanga, momo tūāhua, rānei whakamāramatanga ā-māmā.
about.step_2_body: Tīpakohia te urunga hapa e tino hāngai ana. Ka rārangi ngā hua mā te hāngai.
about.step_3_body: Tāpiritia he tohu tūnga (p.t. "Katoa:") me te whakamahi i te māra AI Whakaiti ki te whakarite i ngā kupu.
about.step_4_body: Kōpihia te whakamāramatanga me ngā tūnga whakatika ā-tika ki tō ripanga tātura rānei pūrongo.
about.feature_ai_body: Whakaiti i tētahi whakamāramatanga hapa mā tētahi tuhipoka poto. Tō kī API, tō kaiwhakarato AI — kāore e penapena ana i te taha-tūmau.
about.feature_languages_body: Ka wātea te UI i roto i ngā reo 50 neke atu, tae atu ki te tautoko RTL. Hurihia i ngā Tautuhinga.
about.feature_party_body: Kei ngā tautuhinga. I raro i te Kaupeka. Ka mōhio koe ina kite.
about.feature_a11y_body: Hangaia ki te WCAG 2.2: whakahaere aronga, rohe ora, whakatere papapātū, tautoko neke iti, me ngā tohu tino tairite.
about.coming_auth: Waitohu tūāhukahuka ki Google, GitHub rānei ki te tūhono i ō tautuhinga i ngā pūrere.
about.coming_custom: Tāpiritia ā-tūturu ōu ake urunga hapa, penapena ā-matatapu i te kapua.
about.coming_ai: Ngā kaiwhakarato AI anō: OpenAI, Google Gemini, me ētahi atu.
settings.confirm_reset_all_body: Ka ūkui tēnei i ngā tautuhinga katoa — tae atu ki ō kī API — ā ka huri ngā mea katoa ki ngā taurite. Kāore e taea te huri whakamuri.
settings.confirm_reset_all_yes: Āe, tautuhi anō ngā mea katoa
